title: benchmarkEvents
responsibility: Parses provider JSON event streams into completed turns with session identity and available usage.

inputs.name: benchmarkEvents.stdout
inputs.description: Newline-delimited JSON text from a provider stdout stream; each nonempty split line is parsed as one runner event. Each event needs a string type, optional supplied identifiers and model must be nonempty strings, and optional usage and cost counts must be finite and nonnegative.

inputs.name: codexTurn.events
inputs.description: Runner events supplied for Codex turn extraction. The conversion uses the first thread.started event for thread_id, the last turn.completed event for model and usage, and checks all events for turn.failed.

inputs.name: claudeTurn.events
inputs.description: Runner events supplied for Claude turn extraction. The conversion uses the first system/init event for model and the last result event for session, usage, error status, and success subtype.

outputs.name: benchmarkEvents
outputs.description: Runner events parsed from retained lines and returned in source order. The function trims stdout before splitting, filters empty split lines, and validates each retained record against the runner event schema.

outputs.name: codexTurn
outputs.description: A completed Codex turn using the first thread.started event thread_id and the last turn.completed event model and usage. Missing model or token counts remain undefined, and this conversion supplies no cost field.

outputs.name: claudeTurn
outputs.description: A completed Claude turn using the last result event session ID, usage, and cost, with the first system/init event model when present. Missing model or result metrics remain undefined.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.parse when a nonempty split line is not valid JSON.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Thrown when parsed JSON does not satisfy the runner event schema, including invalid field types, empty supplied identifiers or model, or negative or nonfinite usage and cost counts.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by codexTurn when its session or completion conditions fail, or by claudeTurn when its result does not satisfy the session and success conditions.
